title: wkfind: Multi-keyword code search with GlobCoverageScore ranking
desc: Smart keyword extraction (skill-search compatible) with PHRASE/AND/OR tier ranking, git diff auto-detection, time-range fallback, and parallel triad analysis
steps: GlobCoverageScore ranking: tokenize keywords by Unicode non-letter/non-digit delimiters. Score each match as token_length/field_length. Results grouped into tiers: PHRASE (keywords consecutive, ×2.5 multiplier)
OR (either keyword, ×1.0 multiplier). Within each tier, results sorted by descending score.
Time-range fallback (auto-expand on <3 results): --day → --week → --month → --year → --unlimited. Threshold 3 is hardcoded.
Git diff support: auto-detects C:\Users\kiexp\AppData\Local\Temp\wkfind-git.diff. If present, searches diff instead of source files; source label switches.
Current directory context: works from any project folder. Searches from current dir and all subdirs only. Does NOT cross project boundaries.
Parallel triad (GPT+Gemini+Claude) background analysis runs in parallel. Timeout: \ (default 60s).
author: claude
